document_title: Standards Applicability Framework with Operational Mode Conditionality V2
framework_purpose: Defines the exact technical and operational conditions under which specific safety standards apply to the research vehicle platform, establishing strict conditionality for driverless vs remote-controlled operating modes.
compliance_claim_disclaimer: ABSOLUTE DISCLAIMER: Zero claims of statutory compliance, formal certification, or conformity are asserted. Standards are referenced for technical benchmarking and methodology only.

iso_3691_4_conditionality.standard_title: Industrial trucks - Safety requirements and verification - Part 4: Driverless industrial trucks and their systems

driverless_automated_mode.operating_condition: Vehicle navigates autonomously or follows automated guided dispatch without continuous manual operator intervention.
driverless_automated_mode.applicable_clauses: Clause 4 (Safety functions, protective fields), Clause 5 (Verification of safety requirements), Annex A (Braking and stopping distance calculations).

remote_controlled_mode.operating_condition: Vehicle is operated via portable wireless pendant, remote operator console, or manual tethered controller.
remote_controlled_mode.scope_limitation_rationale: ISO 3691-4:2023 Scope Clause 1 explicitly excludes trucks with remote control when the remote operator has continuous direct sight and control. Remote-controlled operations are governed instead by ISO 3691-1 (General safety requirements) and EN 1175 (Electrical requirements). ISO 3691-4 CANNOT be claimed to govern remote-controlled operations.

tier_1_authoritative_applicable_standard.standard_title: Safety of machinery - Safety-related parts of control systems - Part 1: General principles for design
tier_1_authoritative_applicable_standard.role: Guides design and architecture (Category 4, PLe) for the dual-channel emergency stop loop.

tier_1_authoritative_applicable_standard.standard_title: Safety of machinery - Safety-related parts of control systems - Part 2: Validation
tier_1_authoritative_applicable_standard.role: Defines test procedures for fault simulation, cross-monitoring, and contactor diagnostic timing.

tier_1_authoritative_applicable_standard.standard_title: Driverless industrial trucks and their systems
tier_1_authoritative_applicable_standard.role: Applicable strictly when operating in driverless/automated mode; outside scope for remote-controlled mode.

tier_2_reference_standards.standard_title: Functional safety of E/E/PE safety-related systems
tier_2_reference_standards.role: Foundational meta-standard; reference for vendor component SIL certificates (e.g. Pilz safety relay).
Protocol reference for multi-modal sensor timestamp distribution (Gate C1).

tier_2_reference_standards.standard_title: Recommended Practices for Modulating Current in High-Brightness LEDs
tier_2_reference_standards.role: Reference for Flicker Index and Percent Flicker definitions. Does NOT mandate the project's exact FI/frequency pair.

tier_2_reference_standards.standard_title: Photometry - Classification of illuminance meters and luminance meters
tier_2_reference_standards.role: Class B photometer accuracy requirements for Gate C7 Path 1.

tier_3_potentially_applicable_standards.role: Informative draft reference only; must not be cited as an approved standard.

tier_3_potentially_applicable_standards.standard_title: Safety Standard for Driverless, Automatic Guided Industrial Vehicles
tier_3_potentially_applicable_standards.role: North American reference standard for AGV clearances and emergency stop interfaces.

tier_4_out_of_scope_standards.role: Excluded by scope (passenger and commercial road vehicles). Concepts used solely as informative analogies.
Excluded by scope (road vehicle automated driving systems). Zero regulatory relevance to warehouse DAQ.
